programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack.

After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story.

programme.desc: Lowly FBI clerk Walter Weed (Tom Berenger) unwittingly becomes the target of assassins when gangland kingpin Hal Leuco places a bounty on his life. Responding to the call, a motley assortment of hit men -- including poisons expert Ariella Martinez (Martha Higareda), drill-toting lunatic The Surgeon (Vinnie Jones) and masked assassin Lazlo Soot (Tommy Flanagan) -- are in hot pursuit of agent Weed. Now Weed's only hope for survival lies in the hands of FBI agent Zane Baker (Clayne Crawford).

Determined to make things perfect, she gamely leads Lillian and the other bridesmaids down the wild road to the wedding.

However, when Bradley is assassinated by Bulgarian arms dealer Rayna Boyanov (Rose Byrne), Susan wrangles her way into her first undercover assignment to help capture Boyanov and avenge Bradley.

programme.desc: Annie (Kristen Wiig) is a single woman whose own life is a mess, but when she learns that her lifelong best friend, Lillian (Maya Rudolph), is engaged, she has no choice but to serve as the maid of honor. Though lovelorn and almost penniless, Annie, nevertheless, winds her way through the strange and expensive rituals associated with her job as the bride's go-to gal. Determined to make things perfect, she gamely leads Lillian and the other bridesmaids down the wild road to the wedding.

programme.title: Super Troopers
programme.desc: Always looking for action, five over-enthusiastic but under-stimulated Vermont State Troopers raise hell on the highway, keeping motorists anxiously looking in their rear-view mirrors. Between an ongoing feud with the local cops over whose you-know-what is bigger, and the state government wanting to shut them down, the "Super Troopers" find themselves precariously and hilariously heading toward calamity as they try to avoid extinction.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces
programme.desc: Sleazy entertainer Buddy "Aces" Israel incurs the wrath of crime boss Primo Sparazza when he agrees to testify against the Las Vegas mob. Two FBI agents have the difficult task of protecting him from a motley assortment of bounty hunters, hit men and nefarious vixens who are converging on his Lake Tahoe encampment to rub him out and collect a hefty reward.

programme.title: Smokin' Aces 2: Assassins' Ball
programme.desc: Lowly FBI clerk Walter Weed (Tom Berenger) unwittingly becomes the target of assassins when gangland kingpin Hal Leuco places a bounty on his life. Responding to the call, a motley assortment of hit men -- including poisons expert Ariella Martinez (Martha Higareda), drill-toting lunatic The Surgeon (Vinnie Jones) and masked assassin Lazlo Soot (Tommy Flanagan) -- are in hot pursuit of agent Weed. Now Weed's only hope for survival lies in the hands of FBI agent Zane Baker (Clayne Crawford).

programme.title: That's What She Said
programme.desc: In Manhattan, two best friends (Anne Heche, Marcia DeBonis) and their new acquaintance (Alia Shawkat) bond over relationship troubles and an adventure in the city.

programme.title: Helicopter Mom
programme.desc: The overbearing mother (Nia Vardalos) of a sexually confused teenager (Jason Dolley) tells everyone that he's gay and submits an application on his behalf for a college scholarship for LGBT students.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoun (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Canton (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy).

programme.title: Rapture-Palooza
programme.desc: Left behind after the Rapture, a young woman (Anna Kendrick) and her boyfriend (John Francis Daley) set out to prevent the Antichrist (Craig Robinson) from taking her as his unholy bride.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: While still a teen himself, Donny (Adam Sandler) fathered a son, Todd (Andy Samberg), and raised him as a single parent. On Todd's 18th birthday, Donny cut the youth loose. After years of estrangement, the older man shows up unexpectedly on the eve of his son's wedding day, sending the young man's life into a tailspin. Donny wants desperately to reconnect with Todd, but he must now deal with the repercussions of the bad parenting he exhibited in the past.

programme.title: Easy A
programme.desc: Prompted by her popular best friend to spill details of her boring weekend, Olive, a clean-cut teen, decides to spice things up by telling a little lie about losing her virginity; when the high-school busybody overhears the conversation and spreads it all over campus, Olive is suddenly notorious but for the wrong reasons.

programme.desc: Three women utilize their newly formed sisterhood to battle sexism, bad relationships and low self-esteem. They soon find the secret to ultimate fulfillment by embracing their wild adventures.

programme.title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
programme.desc: T.S. is invited to the Smithsonian to receive an award for inventing a perpetual motion machine. Without telling any of his family, he boards a freight train heading to Washington, D.C., to attend the ceremony.

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Posing as an abandoned toddler, a very small fugitive (Marlon Wayans) from the law tricks a couple (Shawn Wayans, Kerry Washington) into taking him in. Once there, the baby-faced thief endures the other man's attempts at fatherhood while waiting for a chance to take back the stolen gem he hid in the wife's purse.

programme.title: Trippin'
programme.desc: A high-school senior, Gregory Reed (Deon Richmond) is unprepared for life after graduation. Obsessed with finding a girlfriend, Gregory often has elaborate fantasies where he imagines himself as a successful ladies' man. While Gregory passes the time with his slick, trouble-seeking friend, June (Donald Adeosun Faison), he can't seem to escape his rut until he meets the pretty and brainy Cinny (Maia Campbell). Although his crush already has a boyfriend, Gregory is intent on winning her over.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline.

programme.title: Major Payne
programme.desc: Maj. Benson Payne lives, breathes and sleeps war. But after being honorably discharged from the Marines due to a lack of wars, Payne, the natural-born killer, has absolutely no idea how to cope in everyday civilian life. Fortunately, before he completely breaks down, Payne finds his way back into a military capacity at Madison Preparatory School, leading a group of misfit JROTC students who don't want to be led. Whipping these kids into shape might be his toughest battle yet.

programme.title: Lesbian Vampire Killers
programme.desc: Two best buddies (James Corden, Mathew Horne) encounter a nest of beautiful Sapphic bloodsuckers.

programme.title: Happy Endings
programme.desc: Filmmaker Nicky (Jesse Bradford) offers to track down the son that Mamie (Lisa Kudrow) gave up for adoption nearly two decades before. Meanwhile, Mamie's stepbrother (and the father of her child), Charley (Steve Coogan), along with his boyfriend, Gil, try to find out what became of the sperm Gil donated to a lesbian couple. Finally, singer Jude (Maggie Gyllenhaal) becomes entangled in a love triangle with androgynous drummer Otis (Jason Ritter) and his conservative father (Tom Arnold).

programme.title: Think Like a Dog
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy develops a telepathic connection with his dog after a middle-school science experiment goes awry.

programme.title: The Sixth Man
programme.desc: Brothers Kenny (Marlon Wayans) and Antoine Tyler (Kadeem Hardison) have always wanted to be basketball heroes, standing out as child athletes and now as college players at the University of Washington. But tragedy strikes during a game, when Kenny, the superstar of the family, sustains a fatal heart attack while playing. This forces Antoine to become the leader on the court, but not without some help from his brother, who returns as a ghost to help the Washington team in its quest for glory.

programme.title: After Sex
programme.desc: Eight couples experience the joys and difficulties of relationships.

programme.title: Jack Goes Boating
programme.desc: Single Jack (Philip Seymour Hoffman) drives a limo for a living and has a best friend, Clyde (John Ortiz), a married co-worker. Clyde and his wife decide to set up Jack with another friend, Connie (Amy Ryan). Jack and Connie hit it off, and a tentative romance blossoms, inspiring Jack to take cooking lessons, learn to swim, and apply for his dream job. However, as that relationship grows stronger, Clyde and his wife find their marriage crumbling.

programme.title: Good Fortune
programme.desc: A well-meaning but inept angel named Gabriel meddles in the lives of a struggling gig worker and a wealthy venture capitalist.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Dorm Daze 2
programme.desc: College students take a chaotic cruise on a ship containing a priceless stolen jewel.

programme.title: Lady of the Manor
programme.desc: Past and present collide when slacker Hannah gets hired to portray Lady Wadsworth -- a Southern belle from the 1800s -- for tours at Wadsworth Manor. Hannah figures she can fake it well enough, until the ghost of Lady Wadsworth appears and tells her it's time to change her wild ways -- or she'll haunt her forever.

programme.title: You Got Served
programme.desc: David (Omarion Grandberry) and Elgin (Marques Houston) helm a talented street-dancing crew that engages in dance battles in a Los Angeles warehouse belonging to local club owner Mr. Rad (Steve Harvey). When Orange County rich kid Wade (Christopher Jones) challenges David and Elgin to compete against his dancers for $5,000, they accept. As David and Elgin labor to perfect their moves for the competition, tensions within the crew threaten their chances at success.

When Tony is freed, Vince suggests the ex-convict move in with his wife, Joyce (Julianna Margulies), and their children. But because Vince neglects to tell his family that Tony is not just a stranger, but the son he fathered before he met Joyce, this leads to a series of comic misunderstandings.

programme.title: The Siege
programme.desc: After terrorists attack a bus in Brooklyn, a Broadway theater and FBI headquarters, FBI anti-terrorism expert Anthony Hubbard (Denzel Washington) teams up with CIA agent Elise Kraft (Annette Bening) to investigate. Soon, martial law is declared in New York City, and General William Devereaux (Bruce Willis), a sadistic racist, is put in command. When Devereaux begins rounding up Arab-Americans and forcing them into a detention camp, Hubbard and Kraft must fight back in the name of freedom.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: When a violent tragedy shakes the Ridge, the Frasers must lean on their new tenants to make the community whole again.

programme.title: Mo' Money
programme.desc: After petty criminal Johnny (Damon Wayans) falls for the lovely Amber (Stacey Dash), he decides to stop breaking the law and gets a gig at his crush's workplace in order to get closer to her, thus proving that he's a stand-up guy. Soon, he learns that going straight doesn't pay very well, so he decides to nab a company credit card and show off his newfound wealth to Amber. Unfortunately, a blackmailer catches Johnny and forces him to commit a crime that is far from small.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: When a violent tragedy shakes the Ridge, the Frasers must lean on their new tenants to make the community whole again.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
programme.desc: After learning that one of their victims, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya soon finds herself in a brutal fight for survival against psychopaths who are more than willing to kill anyone who stands in their way.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: After losing his mother to murder as a boy, Marcus (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) has little support in his life. He starts working for drug dealer Levar (Bill Duke) and his assistant (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje). Although Marcus makes good money selling, his dream is to become a rapper. When he reunites with an old love (Joy Bryant) and is later shot numerous times during a robbery, Marcus decides it's time to change his life. However, his old associates won't let him go so easily.

In 1946, Branch Rickey (Harrison Ford), legendary manager of the Brooklyn Dodgers, defies major league baseball's notorious color barrier by signing Jackie Robinson (Chadwick Boseman) to the team. The heroic act puts both Rickey and Robinson in the firing line of the public, the press and other players. Facing open racism from all sides, Robinson demonstrates true courage and admirable restraint by not reacting in kind and lets his undeniable talent silence the critics for him.

programme.title: A Lot Like Love
programme.desc: When Oliver and Emily meet on an airplane, they feel an instant connection, but agree that they're wrong for each other. As the years pass and they live their separate lives, fate brings them together several times, and they become close friends. Any time one of them wants more out of the relationship, the other seems content with just being friends. If they wait too long, Oliver and Emily may miss any chance of spending their lives together.

programme.title: Changing Lanes
programme.desc: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.

programme.title: From the World of John Wick: Ballerina

As the pandemic threatens to consume humanity, Gerry leads a worldwide search to find the source of the infection and, with luck, a way to halt its spread.

Their gang leader, Lino, decides to use Gloria for his dirty work to avoid detection from the Drug Enforcement Administration. Determined to get away, Gloria must now play a dangerous game to outwit not only the cartel, but the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity.

programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

programme.title: I Wish You All the Best

After enrolling in a new school, they find support from an eccentric art teacher while forming an unexpected bond with a kindhearted student.

N.W.A's first studio album, "Straight Outta Compton," stirs controversy with its brutally honest depiction of life in Southern Los Angeles. With guidance from veteran manager Jerry Heller, band members Ice Cube (O'Shea Jackson Jr.), Dr. Dre (Corey Hawkins), Eazy-E, DJ Yella and MC Ren navigate their way through the industry, acquiring fame, fortune and a place in history.

Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

The coins attract an assortment of odd suitors, including a sausage merchant, a street magician and an artist. But when a persistent reporter (Josh Duhamel) throws his hat in the ring, Beth wonders if his love is the real thing.

programme.desc: Rebecca thought she had finally fought her way free from the secret world of illegal combat. Now, with her sister in danger, Rebecca must reluctantly return to the life she abandoned to save her sibling and confront the fight club's deranged leader.

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
programme.desc: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

However, 10 years and two children later, the flames of passion have dimmed to dull embers. To bring back the spark, the couple decide to record themselves trying out every position in "The Joy of Sex," which seems like a great idea at the time -- until they discover that their private recording has gone public via the Internet.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 1
programme.desc: After their car breaks down in an eerie small town, a young couple is forced to spend the night in a remote cabin. Panic ensues as they are terrorized by three masked strangers who strike with no mercy and seemingly no motive.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
programme.desc: After learning that one of their victims, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya soon finds herself in a brutal fight for survival against psychopaths who are more than willing to kill anyone who stands in their way.

programme.title: The Other Boleyn Girl
programme.desc: King Henry VIII (Eric Bana) lacks an heir. Seeing this as an opportunity for personal gain, the Duke of Norfolk (David Morrissey) and Sir Thomas Boleyn (Mark Rylance) persuade Thomas' daughter Anne (Natalie Portman) to seduce the king. But Henry falls in love with Anne's sister, Mary (Scarlett Johansson), instead. When Mary becomes pregnant, she's confined to bed, with charged with Anne keeping the king from straying -- but the plan backfires when Anne seeks the king's affections for herself.

programme.title: White Boy Rick
programme.desc: Rick Wershe is a single father who's struggling to raise two teenagers during the height of the crack epidemic in the 1980s Detroit. Wershe sells guns illegally to make ends meet but soon attracts attention from the FBI. Federal agents convince his son, Rick Jr., to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself.

programme.desc: A teenage songwriter is stuck living in the shadow of her deceased Dad's music legacy when the 20-year anniversary of his debut album forces her to face his abandonment.

programme.desc: Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker (Denzel Washington) has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost. Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation.

programme.title: Separate Lives
programme.desc: Lauren Porter (Linda Hamilton) is a respected psychology professor with a troubled past who believes that she might have developed multiple personalities. In order to find help in determining her condition, Lauren recruits a student, ex-police officer Tom Beckwith (James Belushi), to follow her and observe her activities. It soon becomes clear that Lauren does indeed have another personality -- one who happens to be a hedonistic temptress involved in plenty of dubious dealings.

programme.title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
programme.desc: Struggling musician Peter Bretter is better-known as the boyfriend of TV star Sarah Marshall. After she unceremoniously dumps him, he feels lost and alone but makes a last-ditch bid to get over it by going to Hawaii. However, she and her new boyfriend are there in the same hotel.

programme.title: Sex Tape

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: While still a teen himself, Donny (Adam Sandler) fathered a son, Todd (Andy Samberg), and raised him as a single parent. On Todd's 18th birthday, Donny cut the youth loose. After years of estrangement, the older man shows up unexpectedly on the eve of his son's wedding day, sending the young man's life into a tailspin. Donny wants desperately to reconnect with Todd, but he must now deal with the repercussions of the bad parenting he exhibited in the past.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: In 1976, singer Jackie Moon (Will Ferrell) uses the profits from his only hit single to fulfill a longtime dream of owning a basketball team. His team, the Flint Michigan Tropics, is the worst team in the league, and what's more, the franchise may fold when the ABA and NBA announce plans to merge. It's up to Jackie and the Tropics to turn their game around and slam-dunk their chance for survival.

programme.title: Mo' Money
programme.desc: After petty criminal Johnny (Damon Wayans) falls for the lovely Amber (Stacey Dash), he decides to stop breaking the law and gets a gig at his crush's workplace in order to get closer to her, thus proving that he's a stand-up guy. Soon, he learns that going straight doesn't pay very well, so he decides to nab a company credit card and show off his newfound wealth to Amber. Unfortunately, a blackmailer catches Johnny and forces him to commit a crime that is far from small.

programme.title: Jack and Jill
programme.desc: Thanksgiving is usually a happy time, but ad executive Jack (Adam Sandler) dreads the holiday because his twin sister, Jill (also Sandler), makes her annual visit. When Jack and his sister get off on the wrong foot, the only way to make it right is to invite her to stay through Hanukkah. But, when actor Al Pacino (Al Pacino), whom Jack desperately needs to star in a commercial, takes a shine to Jill, Jack may be forced to extend his sister's visit even longer.

programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: All Happy Gilmore (Adam Sandler) has ever wanted is to be a professional hockey player. But he soon discovers he may actually have a talent for playing an entirely different sport: golf. When his grandmother (Frances Bay) learns she is about to lose her home, Happy joins a golf tournament to try and win enough money to buy it for her. With his powerful driving skills and foulmouthed attitude, Happy becomes an unlikely golf hero -- much to the chagrin of the well-mannered golf professionals.

programme.title: Grown Ups
programme.desc: The death of their childhood basketball coach leads to a reunion for some old friends (Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock), who gather at the site of a championship celebration years earlier. Picking up where they left off, the buddies -- with wives and children in tow -- discover why age does not, necessarily, equal maturity.

programme.title: Grown Ups 2
programme.desc: Lenny Feder moves his family back to his hometown to be with his friends, but he finds -- what with old bullies, new bullies, party crashers and more -- that he hasn't left the crazy life behind in Los Angeles. Lenny's friends must also cope with their own challenges: Eric must face his ultimate fear; Kurt has gone back to work as a cable repairman; and Marcus learns that he has an 18-year-old son.

After Moses accidentally shoots Carter, the cop must recover and then bring the two-bit thug in to take the stand against Colton. With Carter and Moses on far from good terms, however, the trip does not go well.

While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret.

programme.title: Outlaw Johnny Black
programme.desc: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: When former U.N. investigator Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) and his family get stuck in urban gridlock, he senses that it's no ordinary traffic jam. His suspicions are confirmed when, suddenly, the city erupts into chaos. A lethal virus, spread through a single bite, is turning healthy people into something vicious, unthinking and feral. As the pandemic threatens to consume humanity, Gerry leads a worldwide search to find the source of the infection and, with luck, a way to halt its spread.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack.

programme.title: You Again
programme.desc: Marni is shocked to learn that her brother is marrying her school bully from the past. When she tries to expose her, things do not go as planned.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: As a beautiful young woman of pure heart, Maleficent (Angelina Jolie) has an idyllic life in a forest kingdom. When an invading army threatens the land, Maleficent rises up to become its fiercest protector. However, a terrible betrayal hardens her heart and twists her into a creature bent on revenge. She engages in an epic battle with the invading king's successor, then curses his newborn daughter, Aurora -- realizing only later that the child holds the key to peace in the kingdom.

programme.title: The Perfect Guy
programme.desc: With a fulfilling career and a loving relationship, lobbyist Leah Vaughn (Sanaa Lathan) seems to have it all. Things come crashing down when Dave, her long-term boyfriend, questions her future plans for marriage and a family. The resulting breakup leaves Leah heartbroken, until she meets the charming and handsome Carter Duncan (Michael Ealy). Soon, the budding romance turns dangerous as Carter reveals his volatile nature, forcing Leah to turn the tables on the man she thought was Mr. Right.

programme.title: Baby Mama
programme.desc: When single executive Kate Holbrook (Tina Fey) decides the time is right to finally have a baby, she hires a working-class woman (Amy Poehler) from South Philadelphia to act as her surrogate mother. However, Kate's careful planning goes out the window when the woman shows up on her doorstep needing a place to live. A comic battle of wills breaks out between the pair as they prepare for the blessed event and try not to kill one another in the process.

programme.title: Paper Soldiers
programme.desc: A rookie thief receives on-the-job training from a crew of bungling burglars.

Mercer is desperately trying to rebuild his life and his relationship with his son amid the turbulent Los Angeles riots in 1992. Across town, another father and son put their own strained relationship to the test as they plan a dangerous heist where Mercer works. As tensions continue to rise in the city, both families reach their boiling points when they collide.

programme.title: Me You Madness
programme.desc: A young thief cases an architectural dream house in Malibu, not realizing it is the home of an eccentric female serial killer.

programme.title: Jacob's Ladder
programme.desc: After losing his brother in combat, Jacob Singer returns home from Afghanistan -- only to be pulled into a mind-twisting state of paranoia. Singer soon realizes that his sibling is alive, but life is not what it seems.

programme.title: The Knife
programme.desc: A family's life gets thrown into disarray when they find a mysterious woman in their new home. By the time the police arrive, the intruder is lying unconscious on the floor with a knife in her hand. Questioned by a detective, the couple and their two children try to safeguard one another's secrets. However, the choices they make soon lead to consequences even more graver than they could have imagined.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Eva
programme.desc: Eva has been in charge of her younger sisters ever since their parents died, many years ago. Eva's uncanny ability to interfere in her sisters' affairs has not endeared her to their spouses and partners. The men would like to close out and divide up the family trust fund that Eva oversees. So they concoct a simple plan: compensate cash strapped ladies' man Ray Adams (LL Cool J) to romance and distract Eva from her familial duties. Sparks fly between Ray and Eva ... but the plan goes awry.

programme.title: The Siege
programme.desc: After terrorists attack a bus in Brooklyn, a Broadway theater and FBI headquarters, FBI anti-terrorism expert Anthony Hubbard (Denzel Washington) teams up with CIA agent Elise Kraft (Annette Bening) to investigate. Soon, martial law is declared in New York City, and General William Devereaux (Bruce Willis), a sadistic racist, is put in command. When Devereaux begins rounding up Arab-Americans and forcing them into a detention camp, Hubbard and Kraft must fight back in the name of freedom.

programme.title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
programme.desc: Roman J. Israel is an idealistic defense attorney whose life gets upended when his boss and mentor -- the legendary civil rights icon William Henry Jackson -- dies unexpectedly. He's then recruited to join a law firm led by George Pierce, an ambitious lawyer who was one of Jackson's former students. Israel's legacy of activism soon gets put to the test when he takes on the case of Langston Bailey, a young man accused of murdering a convenience store clerk.

As tensions continue to rise in the city, both families reach their boiling points when they collide.

programme.title: The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare
programme.desc: British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and a group of military officials hatch a daring plan to neutralize Hitler's fleet of German U-boats during World War II. Made up of a motley crew of rogues and mavericks, the top-secret combat unit uses unconventional techniques to battle the Nazis and change the course of the war.

programme.title: Spy
programme.desc: Despite having solid field training, CIA analyst Susan Cooper (Melissa McCarthy) has spent her entire career as a desk jockey, working hand-in-hand with dashing agent Bradley Fine (Jude Law). Using high-tech equipment and a hidden earpiece, Susan is the guardian angel who helps Bradley avoid danger. However, when Bradley is assassinated by Bulgarian arms dealer Rayna Boyanov (Rose Byrne), Susan wrangles her way into her first undercover assignment to help capture Boyanov and avenge Bradley.

programme.title: Super Troopers
programme.desc: Always looking for action, five over-enthusiastic but under-stimulated Vermont State Troopers raise hell on the highway, keeping motorists anxiously looking in their rear-view mirrors. Between an ongoing feud with the local cops over whose you-know-what is bigger, and the state government wanting to shut them down, the "Super Troopers" find themselves precariously and hilariously heading toward calamity as they try to avoid extinction.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.

programme.title: Stomp the Yard: Homecoming
programme.desc: A troubled youth (Collins Pennie) must put his problems aside to lead a dance troupe in a national competition.

programme.title: The Final Cut
programme.desc: In the future, microchips in people's heads record their experiences. Alan Hakman (Robin Williams), a "cutter," edits footage from immoral dead people into pleasing narratives. Alan is troubled by childhood memories and has a difficult relationship with a bookstore clerk (Mira Sorvino). Fletcher (James Caviezel), an ex-cutter, offers Alan $500,000 for footage of a prominent technology manager. Alan refuses, but when he tries to destroy the footage, he learns a dark secret about himself.

programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Two young lovers from different backgrounds meet and fall in love on the ill-fated maiden voyage of the unsinkable R.M.S. Titanic.

Israel's legacy of activism soon gets put to the test when he takes on the case of Langston Bailey, a young man accused of murdering a convenience store clerk.

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York.

programme.title: Django Unchained

Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. programme.title: Titanic
programme.desc: Two young lovers from different backgrounds meet and fall in love on the ill-fated maiden voyage of the unsinkable R.M.S. Titanic.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: Dockworker Ray Ferrier (Tom Cruise) struggles to build a positive relationship with his two children, Rachel (Dakota Fanning) and Robbie (Justin Chatwin). When his ex-wife, Mary Ann (Miranda Otto), drops them off at Ferrier's house, it seems as though it will be just another tension-filled weekend. However, when electromagnetic pulses of lightning strike the area, the strange event turns out to be the beginning of an alien invasion, and Ferrier must now protect his children as they seek refuge.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: A top Marine sniper, Bob Lee Swagger, leaves the military after a mission goes awry and disappears without a trace. Swagger is coaxed back into service after high-profile government officials convince him to help thwart a plot against the President of the United States. Swagger realizes he has been betrayed and becomes the target of a nationwide manhunt. Instead of hiding, he seeks revenge against some of the most powerful and corrupt leaders in the free world.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

programme.title: Seized
programme.desc: A former special forces agent's son is kidnapped and must now wipe out three dangerous crime syndicates, if he wants to see his son alive again.

programme.title: Navy SEALS v Demons
programme.desc: Deep in America, an elite unit goes under cover to save a town from demons.

programme.title: The 2nd
programme.desc: A Secret Service agent must save his son and the daughter of a Supreme Court justice from armed terrorists.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores (Jennifer Lopez) is traveling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist (Eric Stoltz) and a cameraman (Ice Cube), come across Paul (Jon Voight), who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behavior puts everyone on edge. They realize too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune -- if they can catch it.

programme.title: The Marine
programme.desc: A discharged soldier (John Cena) returns home from Iraq and finds that his wife (Kelly Carlson) has been kidnapped by the gang of a murderous jewel thief (Robert Patrick). Soldier John Triton must use all his military skills to rescue his wife from her ruthless captors.

programme.title: Shooter

The twist: Neither man knows that the other is an undercover agent. When their attempt to infiltrate a Mexican drug cartel and recover millions goes haywire, the men are disavowed by their superiors. Trench and Stigman must go on the run lest they wind up in jail or in a grave.

But the nightmare continues for Anthony and his friends as they suffer the indignities of trying to find steady work and provide for their families in a flagging economy. As desperation takes hold, Anthony teams up with Skip (Chris Tucker), a drug addict, and Kirby (Keith David), a small-time crook, to pull off a bank heist that will give them all a chance for a better life.

programme.title: Stomp the Yard
programme.desc: After his brother's death, a troubled but gifted street dancer enrolls in Atlanta's Truth University. As he tries to concentrate on his studies and woo a pretty classmate, he finds himself in the middle of a tug-of-war between fraternities, who want to utilize his talents in an upcoming dance competition.

programme.title: Stomp the Yard: Homecoming
programme.desc: A troubled youth (Collins Pennie) must put his problems aside to lead a dance troupe in a national competition.

programme.title: Chocolate City
programme.desc: Michael (Robert Ri'chard) takes a job as an exotic dancer to make ends meet, and as the money rolls in, he has to deal with the attention of the female club goers while hiding his job from his mother (Vivica A. Fox) and girlfriend.

programme.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
programme.desc: The Four Horsemen and a new generation of illusionists join forces to steal the world's largest diamond from a South African mogul who heads an international crime syndicate.

programme.title: Unstoppable
programme.desc: When a massive, unmanned locomotive roars out of control, the threat is more ominous than just a derailment. The train is laden with toxic chemicals, and an accident would decimate human life and cause an environmental disaster. The only hope of bringing the train to a safe stop is in the hands of a veteran engineer (Denzel Washington) and a young conductor (Chris Pine), who must risk their lives to save those in the runaway's path. Inspired by true events.

programme.desc: Still grieving after the murder of her boyfriend, hairdresser Justice (Janet Jackson) writes poetry to deal with the pain of her loss. Along for the ride is Chicago's co-worker, Lucky (Tupac Shakur), to whom Justice grows close after some initial problems. But is she ready to open her heart again?

programme.title: Hope for Love
programme.desc: A young woman must choose between her cheating husband, the father of her son, or an old flame who makes her feel special.

programme.title: Tales From the Hood
programme.desc: A creepy mortician, Mr. Simms (Clarence Williams III), attempts to scare teenage drug dealer Stack (Joe Torry) and his friends straight by telling them four horrifying stories. One is about a guilt-riddled cop (Anthony Griffith) who goes crazy after ignoring his corrupt partner (Michael Massee). He also tells of a meek schoolboy (Brandon Hammond) with terrifying supernatural powers. Although the young thugs want to take their drugs and escape Mr. Simms, he still has two more tales to tell.

programme.title: Menace II Society
programme.desc: After growing up in the gang lifestyle of the Los Angeles projects, 18-year-old Caine Lawson (Tyrin Turner) wants a way out. Everyone around him, including his unpredictable friend O-Dog (Larenz Tate), is trapped in their lives of crime and violence. With the help of his caring teacher (Charles Dutton) and supportive girlfriend (Jada Pinkett), Caine plans to leave the city for good. But in a series of tragic events, Caine realizes that escape will not be easy.

programme.title: Five Fingers
programme.desc: Martijn (Ryan Phillippe), an idealistic Dutch pianist, arrives in Morocco to start a relief program for malnourished children. Shortly after his arrival, he is kidnapped by terrorists, who interrogate and torture him in an abandoned warehouse. To save his life, Martijn must convince the terrorist leader (Laurence Fishburne) that he is innocent of any wrongdoing and that his intentions are solely altruistic.

programme.title: From the World of John Wick: Ballerina
programme.desc: Trained in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma, Eve Macarro takes on an army of killers as she seeks revenge against those responsible for the death of her father.

programme.title: Changing Lanes
programme.desc: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.

programme.title: La noche del demonio: La puerta roja

El problema es que el plan no sale como lo habían diseñado.

programme.desc: Una mujer es brutalmente asesinada en la isla de Pepparholm en la base del puente. Resulta que la mujer asesinada es Margrethe Thormod, directora general de la Agencia de Migración en Copenhague.

programme.title: Bron (El puente)
programme.desc: Henrik y su nuevo colega, Jonas, continúan investigando el asesinato de Margrethe Thormod. Sus dos principales protagonistas son el grupo radical, Octubre Rojo, y el refugiado desaparecido, Taariq.

programme.title: Bron (El puente)
programme.desc: Henrik y Saga sospechan que Taariq y el experto desaparecido en grupos radicales de izquierda están ocultando algo. Aunque cooperan para revelar esto, no están en la misma línea con respecto al cómo.

programme.title: Bron (El puente)
programme.desc: Taariq reconoce un automóvil relacionado con el caso. Quiere presionar al propietario por dinero, pero él mismo es acusado de robo. Saga teme que habrá más asesinatos.

programme.title: La puta ama
programme.desc: La desaparición de Koistinen pone muy tenso a Börje y las pesadillas de Linda se intensifican. Más tarde, esta decide que es tiempo de ampliar las actividades de "Queen of Homes" y se las ingenia para convencer a todos de que su plan tendrá éxito.

programme.title: The Killing: Crónica de un asesinato
programme.desc: Dos años después de perder su placa, Sarah Lund es ahora guardia de fronteras. Cuando el cadáver de una mujer aparece maltratado y asesinado, su antiguo jefe Brix la llama para que haga lo que mejor sabe hacer.

programme.title: The Killing: Crónica de un asesinato
programme.desc: La policía investiga ahora dos asesinatos, y ambas víctimas tienen antecedentes militares. Sara y Ulrik investigan si existe una relación entre ambos.

programme.title: The New Nurses
programme.desc: Una mujer es ingresada después de sufrir un aborto espontáneo y Lis es la que se encarga de su cuidado. La historia de vida de la mujer le afecta enormemente.

programme.title: The New Nurses
programme.desc: El director del hospital y la matrona idean un nuevo plan para convencer al presidente, el Sr. Hedegaard, de que elija Fredenslund.

programme.title: Salvajes, el cuento del lobo
programme.desc: Unas montañas lejanas, unos pastores aislados, y un gobierno decidido a proteger a un animal invisible. Pero imponer una ley urbana en un entorno rural no será sencillo. En el norte de España un grupo de ganaderos se declara en rebeldía y optan por el autogobierno. En medio del fuego cruzado: fotógrafos, guardabosques y naturalistas. "Salvajes" muestra la España más western en una frenética historia de personajes donde la moral y el daño dependen del lado del valle en que hagas la pregunta.

programme.title: Lingui. Lazos sagrados
programme.desc: A las afueras de N'djamena en Chad, Amina vive sola con María, su única hija de 15 años. Su mundo, que ya es bastante frágil, se derrumba el día que descubre que su hija está embarazada. La adolescente no quiere ese embarazo. En un país donde el aborto no solo está condenado por la religión, sino también por la ley, Amina tiene que hacer frente a una batalla que parece perdida de antemano.

programme.title: Joaquim
programme.desc: Brasil, siglo XVIII. La colonia portuguesa sufre una disminución en su producción de oro. Una minoría portuguesa gobierna una sociedad corrupta y autocrática.

programme.title: Luzzu
programme.desc: Jesmark, un pescador maltés, se enfrenta a una nueva vía de agua en Luzzu, su barco de madera. El barco apenas da para sobrevivir y el hombre ve cómo su medio de vida y una tradición familiar de generaciones están en peligro por la disminución de la faena, una industria pesquera despiadada y un ecosistema estancado. Desesperado por mantener a su mujer y a su hijo recién nacido, que necesita de un tratamiento médico especial, Jesmark se implica poco a poco en una red de pesca ilegal.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: Película que narra la vida de la filósofa y novelista Iris Murdoch centrándose en la historia de amor con su marido John Bayley, sus avances académicos y, sobre todo, en la forma en que hizo frente al Alzheimer antes de morir en 1999.

programme.title: Begin Again
programme.desc: La pasión por la música lleva a Gretta y a Dave, novios desde el instituto, hasta Nueva York. Sin embargo cuando él, una vez alcanzado el éxito y la fama, la abandona, ella se queda completamente desolada. Una noche, un productor de discos recién despedido, la ve actuar en un bar de Manhattan y queda cautivado por su talento.

programme.title: TikTak Cine
programme.desc: Episodio dedicado a explorar la figura de M. Night Shyamalan, el maestro del giro inesperado.

programme.title: Desmontando a Harry
programme.desc: Un exitoso escritor padece un periodo de sequía creativa y no se le ocurre nada para su nueva novela. Ante ello, recuerda eventos de su pasado y escenas de sus libros más vendidos, personajes, reales y ficticios, los cuales vuelven para atormentarlo.

programme.title: El niño pez
programme.desc: En un exclusivo barrio de Buenos Aires, la hija de un juez y la empleada doméstica de la familia se enamoran perdidamente. Harán todo lo posible por escapar a Paraguay, pues sueñan con vivir juntas a orillas de un lago, cerca del niño pez.

programme.title: Optimistas
programme.desc: Se presentan cinco situaciones en las que las personas tienen dificultades para distinguir la verdad de las ilusiones. Cada segmento refleja el lema de Cándido, de Voltaire: "El optimismo es insistir en que todo es bueno, cuando todo es malo".

Soon the sinister little man is on the trail of Butch, Postmaster P. and Stray Bullet, along with Mack Daddy himself.

Unfortunately for the diminutive schemer, well-armed soldiers arrive to foil his plans. Not easily defeated, however, the feisty Leprechaun continues to battle the warriors while also contending with the warped scientist known as Dr. Mittenhand (Guy Siner).

programme.title: Déco ou négo
programme.desc: À Staines-upon-Thames, Kirstie et Phil aident un couple à décider ce qu'il faut faire de leur bungalow à lucarnes. Nitasha voit son potentiel, mais Nikunj n'est pas sûr du tout que ce soit le meilleur choix pour eux.

programme.title: Déco ou négo
programme.desc: Nos experts de l'immobilier retournent voir Dawn et Paul, qui en 2015 étaient tiraillés entre la rénovation de leur maison d'Huddersfield et le déménagement. Quelques années plus tard, de grands changements ont eu lieu.

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: Les restes d'un homme sont retrouvés dans la forêt, après avoir été dévorés par des coyotes-loups, et dans la panique, le chasseur qui l'a trouvé a fait exploser le crâne. Pendant que Hodgins et Wells partent chercher les restes, le Jeffersonian accueille le Dr Beth Mayer, une experte anthropologue si expérimentée qu'elle en rend jalouse Brennan.

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: Le corps d'une jeune étudiante en médecine est retrouvé sous le plancher d'une église abandonnée, où des jeunes prévoyaient de fêter Halloween, à ses côtés un cercueil en fer marqué d'une rune de sorcellerie, dans lequel se trouve les restes d'un général de guerre du XVIIIe siècle à qui il manque la tête.

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: Pendant leur tournée, deux éboueurs retrouvent un corps dans les poubelles. La victime est un sénateur tout juste élu. L'affaire est très sensible pour le FBI et pour Caroline Julian.

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: Les restes d'une magicienne spécialiste des tours d'évasion sont retrouvés dans une forêt. Angela travaille sur ses photos aidée pas Sebastian Kohl.

programme.title: Bones
programme.desc: Le corps d'une journaliste de renom est retrouvé dans le bassin d'un terrain de golf. La victime était au coeur d'une affaire de lanceur d'alerte ayant révélé des documents secrets de la NSA, les soupçons se tournent donc aussitôt vers l'agence.

programme.title: La vallée des mensonges
programme.desc: Élevée loin des Cévennes par son grand-père, Laura revient dans son village natal avec un projet : transformer la maison familiale en maison d'hôtes. Un retour endeuillé par la mort brutale d'une amie d'enfance, décédée dans d'étranges circonstances.

programme.title: L'héritage
programme.desc: Un ostréiculteur de l'Héritage, une exploitation du bassin d'Arcachon, est victime d'une tentative d'assassinat, ses trois filles se pressent à son chevet. Alors que l'enquête des gendarmes piétine, les soeurs décident de mener leurs propres investigations, sans se douter que ce qu'elles vont découvrir peut à tout moment faire exploser la famille.

programme.title: Au cœur du crime
programme.desc: Camp des gens du voyage de Maldormir, près de Marseillan (Hérault), le 14 février 2016. Raynald Barguet, 23 ans, est réveillé en pleine nuit par un mystérieux appel. À l'autre bout du fil, une voix lui demande de sortir de sa caravane sur le champ.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.desc: Le 7 décembre 2016 non loin de Valenciennes (Nord), Alexandre Dubrunfaut, 29 ans, est retrouvé carbonisé dans les restes d'une voiture incendiée. Un mois plus tard, son frère David, 32 ans, est interpellé.

programme.title: Au cœur du crime
programme.desc: Le 11 mai 1995, en plein voyage de noces en Corse, Aurore Martin et Marc Van Beers sont victimes d'un dramatique accident de la route. Avant que la voiture chute vertigineusement du haut d'une falaise, Aurore a le temps de s'éjecter.

programme.title: Au cœur du crime
programme.desc: 8 juillet 2014, Bruxelles. Marc Dellea est retrouvé sans vie dans son lit. Les soupçons des policiers se tournent vite vers Sylvia Boigelot, la compagne de Marc qui entretient une relation extraconjugale avec le député Christian Van Eyken.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.desc: Retour sur des enquêtes criminelles, avec des témoignages de proches des victimes, d'avocats et des forces de police.

programme.title: Piquantes !
programme.desc: Nicole Ferroni, accompagnée de ses piquantes, accueille des personnalités pour piquer encore plus fort. Avec elles, l'humour est une arme de dérision massive pour revisiter et chahuter l'actualité de la semaine.

programme.title: Dr Harrow
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un jeune homme qui disait être le fils de Harrow est retrouvé mort, ce dernier est poussé à comprendre le mystère et se retrouve empêtré dans un monde souterrain de cybercriminalité, de crypto-piraterie et de meurtre.

programme.title: Dr Harrow
programme.desc: Sous le choc d'apprendre que son fils est toujours en vie, Harrow trouve une nouvelle distraction dans l'une des affaires les plus étranges qu'il ait jamais connues : le meurtre d'un vampire.

programme.title: Dr Harrow
programme.desc: Harrow veut prouver une fois pour toutes que Francis Chester est vivant et essaie de le tuer, mais sans preuve, même ses amis et collègues les plus fiables doutent de l'état d'esprit de Harrow.

programme.desc: Kirstie rend visite à Lucia et Matt, qui vivaient auparavant à Royal Wootton Bassett avec une basse-cour pleine de poules, et qui ont finalement vendu et déménagé au Pays de Galles.

programme.title: Déco ou négo
programme.desc: Kirstie et Phil viennent en aide à Nikki et Bash, un couple qui n'a pas les mêmes attentes pour l'avenir : Bash trouve que leur famille manque d'espace et s'imagine à la campagne, tandis que Nikki refuse de quitter sa maison.

programme.title: Déco ou négo
programme.desc: Dans leur maison de Nottingham, Lexi, Ed et leurs enfants se sentent bien à l'étroit. Pour les faire rester, Kirstie devra pousser les murs de leur maison, mais l'inflation va lui mettre des bâtons dans les roues.

programme.title: Déco ou négo
programme.desc: Julie rêve d'une maison plus grande et plus lumineuse tandis qu'Alan ne jure que par celle où ils vivent déjà. Après dix ans de recherches et de disputes, ils font appel à Phil et Kirstie pour enfin mettre un terme au débat.

programme.title: Déco ou négo
programme.desc: Passionnés d'équitation, Heather et Tim possèdent une véritable maison de gentlemen farmers à deux pas d'Edimbourg., mais la construction d'une nouvelle route à proximité de leur terrain va cristalliser les tensions.

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.desc: Le 7 décembre 2016 non loin de Valenciennes (Nord), Alexandre Dubrunfaut, 29 ans, est retrouvé carbonisé dans les restes d'une voiture incendiée. Un mois plus tard, son frère David, 32 ans, est interpellé.

programme.title: Au cœur du crime
programme.desc: Le 29 juin 2012, Marina Ciampi, 52 ans, est retrouvée morte dans son appartement des quartiers nord de Marseille. Elle est nue, les veines tailladées, un sac plastique sur la tête maintenu par le cordon d'un sèche-cheveux autour du cou.

programme.title: Au cœur du crime
programme.desc: Le 28 avril 2019 à La Flèche, Aurélie Mignot est grièvement blessée dans un incendie d'origine criminelle. Le corps brûlé à 60 %, elle s'en sort comme par miracle après quatre mois en soins intensifs.

programme.title: Le prix de la trahison
programme.desc: C'est à Angoulême où elle vit que Marie Jourdan a convié son ami Paul Danceny à fêter son 35e anniversaire de mariage. Malheureusement, la fête est brutalement interrompue par des policiers qui viennent arrêter son fils Alex, marié et père d'une petite fille, pour le meurtre de sa maîtresse.

programme.title: La mort est dans le pré
programme.desc: Le cadavre d'un homme, une étiquette bovine accrochée au cou avec la mention " Peuvent-ils souffrir ? " est retrouvé dans une grosse entreprise d'abattage et de conditionnement de viande de la région de Manosque. Les soupçons de la jeune inspectrice Samira Masson, dont c'est la première enquête, la mènent naturellement vers une association de défense de la condition animale qui orchestrait depuis quelque temps un battage médiatique contre l'entreprise.

programme.title: La négociatrice
programme.desc: Depuis qu'elle travaille pour la police de Detroit, Cameron Grainger s'est imposée comme la meilleure négociatrice. Lorsqu'un petit commerce est braqué par un adolescent et que plusieurs clients sont pris en otages, c'est bien entendu Cameron qui se rend sur les lieux. Mais les choses tournent mal et un homme est tué. Cameron encaisse difficilement cet échec et décide de raccrocher.

programme.title: Obsession rapprochée
programme.desc: Karen, veuve depuis peu, sauve la vie de Jérémy au cours d'une attaque à main armée dans un supermaché. Lorsqu'il apprend qu'elle élève seule son petit garçon, Max, Jérémy décide, pour la remercier, de jouer les bons Samaritains et de lui venir en aide. Mais sa bienveillance devient vite intrusive, voire obsessionnelle...

programme.title: Au coeur du crime
programme.desc: Retour sur des enquêtes criminelles, avec des témoignages de proches des victimes, d'avocats et des forces de police.

programme.title: Au cœur du crime
programme.desc: Camp des gens du voyage de Maldormir, près de Marseillan (Hérault), le 14 février 2016. Raynald Barguet, 23 ans, est réveillé en pleine nuit par un mystérieux appel. À l'autre bout du fil, une voix lui demande de sortir de sa caravane sur le champ.

programme.title: Programmes de nuit
programme.desc: Programmes de nuit.

programme.title: Face au doute
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire de Lola, une jeune femme de 22 ans confrontée aux soupçons de violence conjugale pesant sur son père et qui ne se doute pas que la vérité est bien plus inavouable encore. Lorsque la jeune Lola rentre en France après plusieurs années passées à l'étranger, elle a hâte de retrouver ses parents et son petit frère de 15 ans, Kevin.

programme.title: Face au doute
programme.desc: Hervé est un père de famille qui idolâtre l'héroïne de sa vie, Clara, 17 ans, sa fille unique qu'il élève seul depuis la disparition de sa femme. Hervé a toutes les raisons d'être fier de Clara : la jeune femme est championne de patinage artistique.

programme.title: Face au doute
programme.desc: Jeanne est médecin généraliste et partage sa vie depuis quelques années avec Clément Girard, 47 ans, courtier en assurances. Ce jour-là, à son cabinet, elle reçoit la visite d'une nouvelle patiente, Chloé Lapeyre. Celle-ci arrive en larmes et demande un arrêt de travail en expliquant qu'elle est victime de harcèlement sexuel au travail. La vie de Jeanne bascule quand elle comprend que le harceleur n'est autre que l'homme avec qui elle vit depuis 8 ans.

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Pendant que Spike cherche à déchiffrer un manuscrit dérobé à Giles et fait appel à l'Ordre de Taraka, une secte d'assassins, pour éliminer la Tueuse, Buffy déprime à cause des tests d'orientation organisés par l'école. Pour la consoler, Angel l'invite à la patinoire, mais la soirée est gâchée par l'arrivée d'un dur à cuire - c'était le premier tueur à gages.

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Apparemment la mort de Buffy sous les crocs du Maître, aussi furtive soit-elle, a activé la révélation d'une autre Tueuse. Et Kendra, très à cheval sur le protocole indiqué dans le manuel de la Tueuse a bien du mal à comprendre la vie que mène Buffy, rapport à son petit-ami vampire.

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Tandis que la relation entre Jenny Calendar et Giles progresse, tout le monde pense que le nouveau fiancé de Mme Summers est un amour... sauf Buffy dont le sixième sens de Tueuse dit que tout ne tourne pas rond chez Ted. Au cours d'une altercation, la situation vire au drame quand tous les deux en viennent aux mains. Finalement, tout le monde découvre que Ted a déjà eu trois épouses dont les corps croupissent encore dans des placards...

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Pour les besoins d'un programme scolaire sur la difficulté d'être parent, Buffy doit pouponner un œuf qui ne se décide pas à éclore. Heureusement pour elle, car l'œuf renfermait une sale bestiole.

programme.title: Buffy contre les vampires
programme.desc: Voilà un anniversaire que buffy ne sera pas prête d'oublier. Le monde est en péril depuis que Spike et Drusilla cherchent à rassembler le corps du Juge, un démon immortel si puissant que chaque partie de son corps a été dispersé un peu partout. Pendant ce temps, Jenny Calendar reçoit la visite de son oncle gitan - du même clan que celui qui avait restauré son âme humaine à Angel.

Une fuite de gaz dans le service d'un chirurgien plasticien laisse une patiente dans un état complexe. Bobby rencontre finalement les parents d'Athéna lors d'un dîner mouvementé. L'appel inquiétant d'un enfant au 9-1-1 interpelle Athéna et Maddie.

Avant d'être infirmier secouriste, Chimney a eu un parcours assez atypique. Le jeune homme se destinait à une carrière d'inventeur mais le succès n'étant pas au rendez-vous, il devint barman dans un karaoké.

Chimney est retrouvé dans un état grave par les secours tandis que Maddie est portée disparue. Il est rapidement envisagé que la jeune femme aurait été enlevée par son ex-mari, Doug, un homme violent et psychologiquement instable...

Le centre d'appels doit adopter la procédure habituelle après une coupure de courant massive à l'échelle du système. Les premiers intervenants font face à des explosions dans plusieurs foyers ainsi qu'à un accouchement difficile.
Une fête de départ pour un directeur de banque se transforme en urgence, puis en mystère. Les premiers secouristes arrivés sur les lieux sont accusés d'avoir réalisé un braquage audacieux.
Après le terrible drame familial qu'il a dû affronter dans le Minnesota en 2014, Bobby Nash a combattu ses démons et commencé une nouvelle vie en tant que Capitaine de la caserne de Los Angeles.

Les pompiers interviennent pour sauver un homme de la noyade lorsqu'il tombe dans une citerne de chocolat fondu, ou une femme blessée par un colis piégé. Au coeur de ces drames humains, Maddie s'interroge sur son avenir dans le centre d'appels.

Après l'explosion d'un deuxième colis piégé, les habitants de Los Angeles sont en proie à la panique et les pompiers, policiers et démineurs sont mobilisés sur chaque alerte potentielle. L'une d'elle mettra la vie d'un membre de la caserne en danger.

Un jeune adolescent se retrouve embarqué dans une course poursuite sur l'autoroute. Plusieurs policiers sont à sa poursuite. Le problème est qu'il ne peut pas arrêter sa voiture, ses freins ne fonctionnent plus. L'équipe doit donc trouver rapidement une solution. Plus tard, une femme se fait contrôlée sur la route. Athena se rend vite compte que cette femme est très louche et cache quelque chose.
Un énorme tsunami frappe Santa Monica, mettant en danger les vies de Buck et Christopher.

programme.title: Les secrets du paquebot
programme.desc: Ortiz, journaliste à La Dépêche des Sables d'Olonne, est retrouvé mort assassiné chez lui. Les policiers Diakité et Descamps sont chargés de l'enquête. Alors qu'ils épluchent son ordinateur, ils découvrent que Ortiz travaillait à un roman sur l'Afrique, un paquebot échoué lors d'une tempête en 1920. A bord de ce paquebot qui ralliait les différents ports coloniaux, de nombreux tirailleurs sénégalais rentraient chez eux après la première guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Crime en Lozère
programme.desc: Dans la grotte de l'Aven-Armand, en Lozère, on découvre le corps sans vie de Jérôme Sennac, exploitant agricole et guide bénévole. L'homme a été poignardé en plein coeur. Elisabeth Richard, procureur, et Paul Jansac, commandant, se rendent sur les lieux pour mener l'enquête. Leurs soupçons s'orientent tout d'abord vers Julien Cazagnes, un jeune berger qui avait eu une altercation avec Jérôme peu de temps avant sa mort. Tout l'accuse.

programme.title: Les mystères de l'école de gendarmerie
programme.desc: Pendant les vacances en amoureux d'Emma et Adrien, une instructrice est retrouvée pendue à l'école de gendarmerie. Adrien est aussitôt dépêché sur place. La situation se complique à cause de la jalousie d'Emma à l'égard de Clémentine, la nouvelle collègue d'Adrien. De son côté, Françoise, la mère d'Emma est folle d'inquiétude son compagnon s'est volatilisé avec, pense-t-elle, une maîtresse.

programme.title: Raid dingue
programme.desc: Johanna Pasquali est une policière pas comme les autres. Distraite, rêveuse et maladroite, elle est d'un point de vue purement policier sympathique, mais totalement nulle. Dotée pourtant de réelles compétences, sa maladresse fait d'elle une menace pour les criminels, et elle veut surtout être la première femme à intégrer le groupe d'élite du RAID. Acceptée au centre de formation du RAID, elle se retrouve alors avec l'agent le plus misogyne du groupe.

Sa vie est à l'image d'une plume qui se laisse porter par le vent, tout comme Forrest se laisse porter par les événements qu'il traverse dans l'Amérique de la seconde moitié du 20e siècle.

programme.title: Oum le dauphin blanc

programme.title: Oum le dauphin blanc

programme.title: Oum le dauphin blanc

programme.title: Oum le dauphin blanc
programme.desc: Yann, Timéti et Auru découvrent une épave remplie de tikis volés aux habitants de Maotou. Yann retrouve de grosses pierres ressemblant à des boulets de canon autour du navire. Mais le lendemain, des tikis ont disparu et d'autres boulets sont apparus.

programme.title: Oum le dauphin blanc

Pendant que Léna et Anaïs restent auprès de Mistral, Hugo et Angelo foncent prévenir le père de Léna vétérinaire. Cependant la montagne où Mistral s'est blessé n'est pas praticable pour l'ambulance.

programme.title: Le ranch

programme.title: Le ranch

Cependant il en veut toujours plus.

programme.title: My Floating Home
programme.desc: Alan and Val have cashed in their savings, sold and downsized their home, and have entrusted a boat builder in Liverpool to make them their dream narrow boat floating home. But first, they need to learn how to live on the water.

programme.title: My Floating Home
programme.desc: Seasoned floating home couple Pat and Sue Willan plan to buy their very last boat and opt for a state-of-the-art, all-mod-cons Dutch barge. They have a budget of over £400,000 and plans for very contemporary kitchen fittings.

programme.title: My Floating Home
programme.desc: Linda and Mark share a one-bedroom floating home on Tagg's Island in Surrey. It's starting to feel a bit cramped, but the couple want to stay put in their exclusive location, so Linda plans to buy the boat next door and do it up all by herself.

programme.title: Waking Ned
programme.desc: Two elderly Irishmen scheme to claim the winnings of a villager who died of shock at hitting a lottery jackpot. When one decides to try to pass off as dead Ned, the rest of the village are in on the deceit, so the authorities will grant the prize.

programme.title: Vendetta for the Saint
programme.desc: Simon Templar wages a one-man war against the Mafia in this feature culled from `The Saint' TV series.

programme.title: Puppet on a Chain
programme.desc: A member of Interpol's Narcotics Bureau ventures to Amsterdam to flush out a gang of heroin smugglers. When a fellow agent is shot dead, he is forced to team up with the local Dutch force. The stage is set for a breathtaking speedboat chase through the canals of Amsterdam.

programme.title: Sex and the Other Woman
programme.desc: A series of vignettes exposing how women manipulate their men into submission.

programme.title: Triple Cross
programme.desc: World War II spy adventure based on the real-life exploits of double agent Eddie Chapman. Imprisoned in Jersey at the time of the German invasion, Chapman offers to spy for the Nazis in exchange for money and freedom. However, once trained and sent to England, he reports to British Intelligence and feeds misinformation to the Germans.

programme.title: Angry Birds

programme.title: Alex y el Mar
programme.desc: Alex vive en una isla y se prepara cada mañana un desayuno mientras Rocco y Lili juegan juntos. Un científico holográfico aparece en una máquina y le dice a Alex cual es su mision para el día: Alex ha de fotografiar un delfín. Descubrirá todo tipo de vida submarina. Despues de un rato, Alex ve un delfín y toma una foto de el. Luego, regresa de vuelta a casa. Al final, una voz explica las características de los delfines.

programme.title: Pintxo Contra el Cambio Climatico
programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a el nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático. Descubre como las pequeñas acciones en casa; como ahorrar agua y apagar luces pueden tener un gran impacto.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a traves de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La produccion musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversion a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de produccion musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristoteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y carton crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creacion y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y el se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicacion de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.

programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger presenta los secretos y las maravillas de la naturaleza y la vida silvestre que nos rodea y estimula la curiosidad y la pasion por la naturaleza en los niños. Con interesantes misiones y aventuras, los niños se divierten mientras aprenden lecciones positivas.

programme.title: A cantar con Fluffy la Conejita
programme.desc: ¡Ayuda a Fluffy a resolver los problemas de sus amigos con rimas divertidas y pegadizas!

programme.title: Bernard
programme.desc: ¡Sigue a Bernard mientras hace un desastre!

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situacion por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristoteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y carton crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creacion y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la accion en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. C

programme.title: El Mundo de Luna
programme.desc: Curiosa por todo y entusiasmada por la ciencia, Luna, de 6 años, y su hermano Júpiter y su mascota Clyde exploran la naturaleza para conocer el mundo.

programme.title: Planeta de Niños
programme.desc: Divertida y cautivadora serie educativa y de entretenimiento para niños, que refuerza virtudes fundamentales y modales enseñados a los niños por sus padres y maestros, en la escuela y en casa. Desde la confianza, humildad y el perdon, a la honestidad, responsabilidad, cooperacion y dignidad. El show ayuda a los niños a comprender la importancia desde pequeños detalles como ser corteses, hasta a desarrollar grandes virtudes y habilidades, como saber toma de decisiones.

programme.title: Leoncito Alado
programme.desc: LEONCITO ALADO es un canal de canciones infantiles para niños de 1 a 3 años de edad. Aquí podrás encontrar canciones para tranquilizar, entretener y enseñar valores y talentos a nuestros pequeños espectadores.

programme.title: Alex y el Mar
programme.desc: Alex vive en una isla y se prepara cada mañana un desayuno mientras Rocco y Lili juegan juntos. Un científico holográfico aparece en una máquina y le dice a Alex cual es su mision para el día: Alex ha de fotografiar un delfín. Descubrirá todo tipo de vida submarina. Despues de un rato, Alex ve un delfín y toma una foto de el. Luego, regresa de vuelta a casa. Al final, una voz explica las características de los delfines.

Les premiers grimpeurs parlent de l'évolution du matériel et de l'escalade au fil du temps.

programme.title: Andrea
